tests.name: eq_differ
tests.cmd: eq a vs c soft differ; REQUIRE exit 2

tests.name: unhex_bad
tests.cmd: odd length abc; zz nibble; REQUIRE

tests.name: ensure_add
tests.cmd: ensure mode soft NEW=1; ensure mode hard stays soft

tests.name: eq_miss
tests.cmd: missing path soft eq path miss

weaknesses.title: HASHFILE FNV-1a 32-bit vs HEX full payload — dual fingerprint models
weaknesses.detail: Agents confuse short HASH stamps with cryptographic integrity. HEX is full content; HASH is 8-hex FNV. Naming suggests stronger than collision resistance.
weaknesses.repro: HASHFILE vs HEX of same body different widths

weaknesses.title: HEX/BASE64/URLENC encode family sprawl without FILE variants
weaknesses.detail: String-only encode; no HEXFILE/BASE64FILE. Binary artifacts need READ (text plane) then HEX. Same binary gap as BASE64 W from scratch board.

weaknesses.title: EQFILE equal=LAST_N 1 differ=0 both OK=1; path miss OK=0
weaknesses.detail: Agents must branch on OK then LAST_N. Differ looks like soft success with hit=0. Easy REQUIRE glue mistakes.
weaknesses.repro: EQFILE same OK=1 N=1; differ OK=1 N=0

weaknesses.title: KVFILEENSURE create-on-miss invents plates on path typo
weaknesses.detail: Same create footgun as ENSURELINE/KVFILESET. Typo path becomes new config.

weaknesses.title: WRITE/ensure plate trailing NL omit
weaknesses.detail: mode=soft last line no $; cfg glue risk.

weaknesses.title: EQFILE no size-only or mtime-only fast path
weaknesses.detail: Always full content compare; large artifacts expensive. No EQSTAT prefilter.

weaknesses.title: Empty ARG1 blocked for HEX empty string
weaknesses.detail: In-lang HEX "" works; agent empty ARG → needs text.

workarounds: Use EQFILE for equality; HASHFILE only for cheap change detect
HEX for full portable stamps; document FNV limits
EXIST plate before KVFILEENSURE if create unwanted
Digit-check REQUIRE; treat eq N==0 as miss
Prefer BASE64/HEX for text; avoid binary via string READ
language_gaps: EQFILE OK policy document / EQ_DIFFER sticky
